source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For onEmptyCalendarEventRoute in D332509 at revision 3d29fe1d078b26b2f91ee102bc82cfd2308867f1, the AI assessment recommends retaining current-request checks before draft initialization and after awaiting calendar options. The first protects stored state from an already obsolete request; the second prevents a request replaced during loading from restoring old choices or defaults. A later check reportedly covers replacement during dispatch. This is an unaccepted assessment of these guards, not a general requirement to repeat checks around every await. The record reports a passing stale-operation test but explicitly says no guard-removal experiment was performed.
title: Request checks protect separate state changes
